title: "Session 11 guided lab"
subtitle: "Refactor repeated summaries"

::: {.callout-note}
**Suggested use:** tasks 1–6 are the core function-refactoring route. Additional
practice develops a second function family with explicit contracts, stable return
types, iteration, and tests. Unfinished tasks may be completed independently.
:::

Choose one format and copy either `starter/functions-lab.Rmd` or
`starter/functions-lab.qmd` to `work/session11/`. Knit the `.Rmd` file or Render
the `.qmd` file.

## Tasks

1. Complete `safe_mean()` so it validates numeric input, returns `NA_real_` for
   an all-missing vector, and otherwise returns the mean of observed values.
2. Use a preallocated `for` loop to apply it to every marker column.
3. Write `classify_change()` with explicit behavior for missing change values.
4. Test both functions on ordinary, empty, all-missing, and invalid inputs.
5. Refactor the repeated baseline/follow-up code into `change_summary()`.
6. Optional: express the column iteration using `vapply()`.

## Additional practice: design functions from contracts

1. Write `safe_weighted_mean(x, w)` with checks for numeric inputs, equal lengths,
   nonnegative weights, paired missingness, and positive observed total weight.
2. Decide and document whether a missing value in either `x` or `w` removes the
   pair or produces a missing result; encode that choice in an argument.
3. Test ordinary, unequal-length, negative-weight, all-missing, zero-weight, and
   partially missing inputs.
4. Write `marker_profile(data)` that applies `safe_mean()` to numeric columns only
   and returns a data frame with variable name, observed `n`, missing `n`, mean,
   and SD.
5. Apply `marker_profile()` to the complete marker table and to arm-specific
   tables stored in a named list. Verify stable column names and types.
6. Refactor one function so validation and calculation are visibly separated.
   Explain why this makes failures easier to diagnose.
7. Demonstrate that your functions do not depend on or modify a global object by
   changing the global data and rerunning a test with explicit inputs.

### Independent-practice check

Every function must have a stated input/output contract, predictable missing-value
behavior, and at least one test that is expected to fail.

## Exit evidence

Render the function definitions, compact tests, results, and one paragraph about
the input/output contract of `change_summary()`.
